chars.AHMED: AHMED: a slim Moroccan man in his late twenties with short curly black hair and a neatly trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a small black anime-style patch on the chest, light blue jeans, white sneakers and a black crossbody bag
chars.GIRLS: GIRLS: two young Japanese women in their early twenties, one with a short black bob wearing a pastel pink cardigan and a pleated beige skirt, the other with long straight hair wearing an oversized light denim jacket and carrying a white tote bag

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small tidy Tokyo hotel room at morning, AHMED kneels by his open suitcase on the floor with a mischievous excited grin, about to pull something out; window shows Tokyo rooftops. Moroccan-made 2D cartoon illustration, warm colors, main subjects in the center of the vertical frame, calm background at the edges, no text.
